activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and washing face with warm water from the water heater
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and preparing toast with the toaster
Setting up the home workstation: switching on the desk lamp, opening the computer and checking the day's telehealth appointment list
Working as a health care professional: conducting remote telehealth consultations and updating patient records on the computer
Preparing a quick lunch with the induction cooker and eating at the table
Resting on the sofa after lunch, briefly watching the news on the TV
Resuming remote clinical work: telehealth calls, care coordination emails and documenting patient notes on the computer
Doing light household cleaning, vacuuming the living room floor with the vacuum cleaner
Taking a warm shower and changing into comfortable clothes
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and oven, then loading the dishwasher
Relaxing in the evening, watching TV and browsing on the personal phone
Quiet leisure: reading and replying to non-urgent messages on the phone with the fan on low
Night-time hygiene routine: washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet before bed
Sleeping in bed after switching off the light
